extension.description: Local-First, Privacy-First structure visualizer for Markdown, JSON, and YAML without AI.
untrustedWorkspaces.description: StructMap only parses and displays the structure of documents you open. In untrusted workspaces, features that rely on workspace settings (such as custom mappings) are limited.
view.name: StructMap
config.title: StructMap
config.autoRefresh: Enable automatic refresh of StructMap view.
config.debounceMs: Debounce delay for StructMap view updates in milliseconds.
config.maxFileSizeMB: Maximum file size in megabytes to process.
config.maxArrayItems: Maximum number of array items to display directly before chunking.
config.customMappings: Custom glob pattern mappings to parser formats (e.g. { "*_config.json": "json", "*.xlf": "xml" }).
